name: base-doorkey
task: Use the key to open the door, then reach the goal.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The hard clause Existence(door_open) is redundant. Door_open is an intermediate step in the required order has_key -> door_open -> at_goal, and the hard Precedence(has_key, door_open) together with Precedence(door_open, at_goal) and the final Existence(at_goal) already force door_open to occur. Keeping an extra Existence(door_open) adds an unnecessary goal and violates compactness rule 6. Remove the hard Existence(door_open) clause; the remaining clauses correctly capture ‘use the key to open the door, then reach the goal’.

texts: the agent must eventually be on the goal cell
the key must be acquired before the door is opened
the door must be opened before the agent reaches the goal
